d: To perform various tasks pertaining to effective planning of vessel discharge & load operations, yard layouts & operations for Imports, MTs, Exports and Transhipment with due segregation as per department policies and procedures. The planning considers vessel stability, cargo safety & security, an efficient yard and vessel operation. Close real-time monitoring of vessel, berth, yard and gate operations to ensure that vessel, cargo / containers have confirmed positions at any point of time to reduce shifting and unproductive moves either while loading or unloading.
Good understanding of port, shipping and terminal operations, including Dry Bulk, General Cargo, Containers, RoRo and Project Cargo.

Good analytical skills with the ability to identify operational issues and escalate them to the Team Leader.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, for operational data management and reporting.
Working knowledge of port management systems, including PAMS, TOS and IFS.
Ability to prepare daily operational reports, vessel updates, berthing schedules and planning records.
Strong communication, coordination and teamwork skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining vessel, cargo and operational information.
Ability to follow operational procedures, company policies and HSE requirements.
Good time-management skills and the ability to handle multiple operational tasks under pressure.
Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support digitalization initiatives.

Ensure that all HSE instructions are fully understood and complied with.
Must demonstrate total commitment to the company safety policies through participation and proactive involvement.

Responsible to participate in safety meetings and safety drills held on board and ensures operations abide by established/HSE operating procedures and practices, and equipment is used within predetermined capacities

d: Who We Are: At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world’s fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

Summary: We are looking for a Senior Manager, Brand Marketing - Global to drive the long-term growth of our hero and core franchises, the iconic products at the heart of Huda Beauty. You will own the brand strategy and 360 marketing plans for these franchises, lead cross-functional teams to bring them to life, and partner with global and regional teams to keep our icons relevant, desirable and growing all year round. You will also lead brand defense strategies that protect our hero and core franchises’ category leadership against competitive activity.
q: Proven track record leading 360 campaigns across multiple markets.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
Commercially minded, with confidence using data to inform strategy and decision-making.
Track record of presenting strategies and results to senior leadership, backed by sharp creative judgment.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
A passion for beauty and makeup artistry is a must.
10+ years in brand marketing, with strong experience growing hero or core product franchises; prestige beauty strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
r: Own the brand strategy for our hero and core franchises: audience, positioning, messaging and long-term growth plans.
Lead brand defense strategies to protect hero and core franchise category leadership against competitive activity, covering pricing, claims and retail presence.
Build and deliver the annual marketing calendar for the franchise portfolio, from major campaign moments to always-on seasonal and cultural moments.
Lead cross-functional teams (Creative, Communications, Influencer, Paid Media, E-commerce, Retail and Product Development) to deliver 360 campaigns on time and within budget.
Brief and steer Creative to deliver best-in-class, inclusive storytelling and assets.
Drive conversion across every touchpoint, from product pages and claims to in-store presence and media.
Partner with regional teams to translate global strategy into local activation, ensuring consistency across markets.
Track performance, analyze consumer and market trends, and turn insights into action.
Present strategies and results to senior leadership.

d: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Amiri Decision No. 13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic, applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST offers more than 80 bachelor's and master's degree programs, as well as diplomas and certificates. The university comprises five colleges: the College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, as well as specialized training centers catering to individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student-centered learning and state-of-the-art facilities. Its world-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.

With more than 777 staff and over 9,500 students, UDST is the destination of choice for applied and experiential learning. The University is recognized for its student-centered learning and state-of-the-art facilities. Our faculty are committed to delivering pedagogically-sound learning experiences that incorporate innovative learning technologies. Our aim is to enhance students’ skills and help develop talented graduates who can effectively contribute to a knowledge-based economy and make Qatar’s National Vision 2030 a reality.
